dcChargingFromPct.note: The 20 min DC time is a 30–80% charge. 'DC Charging Time 30-80% (minute) 20' — a 30–80% window, not 10–80%.
The 35 min DC time is a 30–80% charge. deepal.com.pk: 'DC fast charging 30-80% in 35 minutes' — a 30–80% window, not 10–80%.
The 15 min DC time is a 30–80% charge. 'DC Charging Time 30 - 80% (Minute) 15'; the website says '30% to 80% in just 15 minutes' (3C charging). A 30–80% window.
The 35 min DC time is a 30–80% charge. deepal.com.pk: 'DC fast charging: 30-80% in 35 minutes' — a 30–80% window, not 10–80%.
The 30 min DC time is a 30–80% charge. Gari.pk launch report: 'DC fast charging 30–80% in about 30 minutes' — a 30–80% window, not 10–80%. Matches the DB notes.

The 30 min DC time is a 30–80% charge. byd-mega.com (Nov 2026): 'Supports BYD ATTO 3 to charge from 30% to 80% within 30 mins*' — a 30–80% window. The Aug 2026 brochure (byd-mega.com/brochure/new/atto-3-brochure-aug-2026.pdf) gives no charge time. The existing DB notes say 29 minutes; the site now says 30.
The 20 min DC time is a 30–80% charge. Deck: '40kW charging pile for fast charging 20min (30%-80%)' and 'Fast charging: 30% to 80% in just 20 minutes'. Window is 30-80%, not 10-80%.
The 19 min DC time is a 30–80% charge. PakWheels Tiggo 7 Premium PHEV FWD page: 'DC charging 40 kW, 30-80% in around 19 minutes'. Window is 30-80%. The brochure only states 'DC charging 40 KW'.
The 15 min DC time is a 20–80% charge. iCAUR Pakistan V27-AWD brochure: '20%~80% Charging Time 15 minutes' (window 20-80%). The DB's 30 min came from PakWheels.
The 28 min DC time is a 30–80% charge. 'supports DC fast charging from 30% to 80% in under 28 minutes' (30-80% window). PakWheels labels the same 28 min as 10-80%.

The 26 min DC time is a 30–80% charge. Australian review of the same 35.4 kWh / 321 kW car: 'a 30 to 80 per cent charge in 26 minutes' at 48 kW (30-80% window). The GWM AU/NZ pages say charge times assume a 48 kW DC charger. No Pakistani source gives a time.
The 30 min DC time is a 30–80% charge. 'DC Fast Charging Time (SOC 30%-80%, 25 C, charging pile power 120 kW) (CCS2) 30 min'. Window is 30-80%, not 10-80%.
The 30 min DC time is a 30–80% charge. 'DC Fast Charging Time (SOC 30%-80%, 25 C, charging pile power 120 kW) (CCS2) 30 min'. Window is 30-80%, not 10-80%. PakWheels instead lists 38 min for 10-80%.

The 32 min DC time is a 30–80% charge. PakWheels RD6 overview: 30% to 80% in about 32 minutes on a 100 kW charger. Window is 30-80%, not 10-80%; not tied to a specific battery, but the Econ uses the 73 kWh pack listed in the same spec table.

The 35 min DC time is a 30–80% charge. MG Pakistan brochure: 'DC Charging (30%-80%) 35 minutes' (30-80% window, not 10-80%). Model page: '10-80% in around thirty-five minutes' - the two official texts disagree on the window. AC (20%-100%) 5.5 hours.

The stored 36 min DC time is a 20–80% charge, per the same iCAUR Pakistan leaflet. iCAUR Pakistan V23 leaflet spec table, V23 RWD column: 'DC Charge Capacity 85kW' (AWD 104kW). Same table: RWD '20%~80% charging time 36 mins', which matches DB dcChargingMinutes.
